summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2027. While SPX/SPY daily P/C ratios are near 1.10, suggesting short-term hedging, the persistent multi-day buying of SPX 7000C (up to $1.8B) and SPX 8000P (over $800M) indicates a "long-vol" or "tail-hedge" strategy paired with extreme long-term upside bets. Significant single-day conviction is also visible in AAPL, with $96.4M in 340C (2028 exp) and META, which shows a heavy bullish bias (P/C 0.41) with $127.2M in BuyCalls. Traders should watch for continued stability in SPX to support these massive long-dated call premiums, as any breakdown could trigger a rapid unwinding of the $1.1B+ SPX 7000C positions.
